title: Pathogen Profile — Edison Science Upstream Contract
description: Defines the complete data contract for a single pathogen instance within the Crusher-to-the-Bridge multi-pathogen concurrent simulation engine. Each pathogen runs through all four transmission pathways independently with separate mass pools per room. Upstream tools (Edison Science, Cursor, Copilot) MUST generate profiles conforming to this schema.

meta.description: Optional metadata header for the profile file.

pathogens.description: One or more pathogen definitions. Multiple pathogens run concurrently during the same simulation with independent mass pools per room.

pathogen_id.description: Unique machine-readable identifier. Used as the key for per-pathogen mass pools (e.g., 'norwalk_gi', 'sars_cov2_resp'). Must be unique across all profiles in the array.

category.description: Epidemiological category. Determines default shedding pathway weights and microflora disruption sites.

transmission_routes.description: Which of the four transmission pathways this pathogen uses. All four pathways are evaluated independently per epoch. The order determines relative weighting in dose attribution logging.

shedding_curve_log10.description: Day-by-day symptomatic shedding rate in log10 copies. Index 0 = day of infection onset. Length determines maximum shedding duration. Typical length: 15 entries.

asymptomatic_shedding_log10.description: Day-by-day asymptomatic/pre-symptomatic shedding rate in log10 copies. Must have same length as shedding_curve_log10.

dose_adjustment.description: Scaling factor applied to raw dose before dose-response evaluation. Higher values = lower effective dose required for infection.

dose_response.description: Korkin Lab dose-response model parameters. P(infection) = 1 - (1 + dose/beta)^{-alpha}

model.description: Dose-response model type. 'beta_poisson' is the standard for Norovirus and respiratory pathogens.

alpha.description: Shape parameter. Lower alpha = steeper dose-response curve.

beta.description: Scale parameter. Higher beta = higher dose required for infection.

illness_probability.description: Probability of clinical illness given infection. P(illness|infection) = eta / (1 + gamma * day_of_infection).

eta.description: Base illness probability. MUST be in [0.0, 1.0].

gamma.description: Day-dependent decay factor. MUST be in [0.0, 1.0].

recovery_day.description: Day of infection at which agent transitions to Recovered state.

surface_deposition_fraction.description: Fraction of shed pathogen mass deposited onto room surfaces per epoch. MUST be in [0.0, 1.0]. Remainder stays airborne.

base_susceptibility.description: Baseline susceptibility multiplier for immunocompetent hosts. Typically 1.0. Immunocompromised agents receive a per-agent multiplier on top of this.

microflora_disruption.description: Defines how this pathogen disrupts the host's native microbiome. When active, infected agents shed altered microbial signatures that GRUMB can detect independently of pathogen mass.

causes_disruption.description: Whether this pathogen causes host microflora disruption.

disruption_magnitude.description: Severity scalar [0,1]. Higher = greater CLR-space shift in GRUMB 4-kingdom arrays.

affected_kingdoms.description: Per-kingdom taxon-level perturbation magnitudes. Keys are kingdom names (Bacteria, Archaea, Fungi, Virus). Values are objects mapping taxon names to CLR shift magnitudes.

introduction_epoch.description: Epoch at which this pathogen is introduced into the simulation. 0 = simulation start. Use values > 0 for mid-cruise pathogen introductions.

initial_infected.description: Number of agents infected with this pathogen at introduction_epoch.
